name: vehicle_spawn_accel
description: CV!=CA stressor: a vehicle spawns stationary just off the corridor and accelerates hard (|a|~2.8 m/s^2, 0->8 m/s) across the drone's path timed to cross mid-corridor. The CV predictor sees v~0 at spawn and under-predicts the sweep; CA/IMM or conformal growth must cover it. No previous scenario source had any accelerating mover.
